queries.query:
import "array"

pv =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -10s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pv_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "inverter_fronius")
        |> aggregateWindow(
            every: v.windowPeriod,
            fn: mean,
            createEmpty: false
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _value: r._value * 0.001
        }))

fallback =
    array.from(rows: [
        {_time: now(), _value: 0.0}
    ])

union(tables: [pv, fallback])
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> last()
    |> yield(name: "mean")

import "array"

meter =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -20s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "meter_household_dlms")
        |> group()
        |> last()
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            _time: "meter_time",
            _value: "meter"
        })
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "latest"}))

pv_data =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -20s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pv_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "inverter_fronius")
        |> group()
        |> last()
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            _time: "pv_time",
            _value: "pv"
        })
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "latest"}))

pv_fallback =
    array.from(rows: [{
        pv_time: now(),
        pv: 0.0,
        joinKey: "latest"
    }])

pv =
    union(tables: [pv_data, pv_fallback])
        |> group()
        |> sort(columns: ["pv_time"], desc: true)
        |> limit(n: 1)

battery =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -20s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery_actual_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "bems_live_zendure_live")
        |> group()
        |> last()
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            _time: "battery_time",
            _value: "battery"
        })
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "latest"}))

meter_pv =
    join(
        tables: {meter: meter, pv: pv},
        on: ["joinKey"],
        method: "inner"
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        joinKey: r.joinKey,
        meter: r.meter,
        pv: r.pv,
        meter_time: r.meter_time,
        pv_time: r.pv_time
    }))

join(
    tables: {power: meter_pv, battery: battery},
    on: ["joinKey"],
    method: "inner"
)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: if r.meter_time > r.pv_time then
            (if r.meter_time > r.battery_time then r.meter_time else r.battery_time)
        else
            (if r.pv_time > r.battery_time then r.pv_time else r.battery_time),
        _value: r.meter + r.pv * 0.001 - r.battery,
        _measurement: "total_household_power"
    }))
    |> yield(name: "total_household_power")

queries.query:
original =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "battery_actual_power" or
            r._measurement == "heat_pump_power" or
            r._measurement == "grid_active_power" or
            r._measurement == "pv_power"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
        |> aggregateWindow(
            every: v.windowPeriod,
            fn: mean,
            createEmpty: false
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            r with
            _value: if r._measurement == "pv_power"
                then r._value * 0.001
                else r._value
        }))

original
    |> yield(name: "original")

calculation =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            (r._measurement == "grid_active_power" and
                r.source == "meter_household_dlms") or
            (r._measurement == "pv_power" and
                r.source == "inverter_fronius") or
            (r._measurement == "battery_actual_power" and
                r.source == "bems_live_zendure_live")
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
        |> aggregateWindow(
            every: 5s,
            fn: mean,
            createEmpty: false
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _value: if r._measurement == "pv_power"
                then r._value * 0.001
                else r._value,
            _measurement: r._measurement
        }))
        |> group()
        |> pivot(
            rowKey: ["_time"],
            columnKey: ["_measurement"],
            valueColumn: "_value"
        )
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            exists r.grid_active_power and
            exists r.pv_power and
            exists r.battery_actual_power
        )
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _value: r.grid_active_power +
                r.pv_power -
                r.battery_actual_power,
            _measurement: "total_household_power",
            _field: "value"
        }))

calculation
    |> yield(name: "total_household_power")
